cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'd love a weekend to patch things up. Separate rooms, though, and no old arguments. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The old arguments are why we need the weekend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then let's start with a pleasant afternoon. We can rebuild from there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't fit everything I need to say into an afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send the rest by email. I'll read it when I'm ready, and we can keep the afternoon for us.

mechanism: A agrees to a repair weekend but directs difficult discussion into limited coffee time and later written material A can receive on A terms.
confusable: Unlike simply scheduling a practical meeting, A protects pleasant shared time from the full complaint; borrowed authority concedes some discussion to retain B participation.
comparison: Separate rooms and emailed overflow differ from repeat dinners with a firm departure time.
seedUse: Use D95-b weekend/rooms/old arguments/afternoon/email and S02-b allowing a workable version of B demand without surrendering A preferred boundary.
